name: Massacre Wurm + Blood Artist + City on Fire — complex interaction
description: Multiple cards interacting: Massacre Wurm's continuous effect kills creatures, Blood Artist and Massacre Wurm both trigger from deaths, City on Fire triples damage. Claude incorrectly lists City on Fire in did_not_trigger.

Massacre Wurm.name: Massacre Wurm
Massacre Wurm.oracle_text:
When Massacre Wurm enters the battlefield, creatures your opponents control get -2/-2 until end of turn.
Whenever a creature an opponent controls dies, that player loses 2 life.

Blood Artist.name: Blood Artist
Blood Artist.oracle_text: Whenever Blood Artist or another creature dies, target player loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.

City on Fire.name: City on Fire
City on Fire.oracle_text:
Convoke
If a source you control would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals triple that damage to that permanent or player instead.

Birds of Paradise.name: Birds of Paradise
Birds of Paradise.oracle_text:
Flying
{T}: Add one mana of any color.

triggers.trigger_text: When Massacre Wurm enters the battlefield
triggers.resulting_effects: Creatures opponents control get -2/-2 until end of turn

triggers.trigger_text: Whenever Blood Artist or another creature dies
triggers.resulting_effects: For each creature that dies, target player loses 1 life and Alice gains 1 life

triggers.trigger_text: Whenever a creature an opponent controls dies
triggers.resulting_effects: Bob loses 2 life for each creature that dies

replacement_effects.replacement_text: If a source you control would deal damage, triple it instead
replacement_effects.what_it_replaces: Life loss from Blood Artist and Massacre Wurm triggers
replacement_effects.what_happens_instead: Each instance of life loss is tripled

continuous_effects.effect_text: Creatures opponents control get -2/-2 until end of turn

did_not_trigger.reason: City on Fire has no triggered abilities.

expected_after_validation.notes: City on Fire removed from did_not_trigger (no trigger text in oracle). All real triggers preserved.
